content: Real-time insights without the lag. Blazing-fast query performance ensures smooth, low-latency analytics for in-game events, player insights, and ad tech—when every millisecond counts.
Built for high-speed event ingestion process millions of in-game events per second with native support for streaming sources like Kafka, Kinesis and Pub/Sub.
Powerful domain-specific functions - SQL functions designed for event-driven data, help you analyze player behavior, optimize game mechanics, and improve ad performance.

High query concurrency - Designed for player-facing analytics, ClickHouse effortlessly supports massive-scale concurrency for real-time leaderboards, player dashboards, in-game ads, and live telemetry. Unlike traditional data warehouses that struggle with high user loads, ClickHouse ensures instant responsiveness even under heavy concurrent queries, making it the ideal choice for interactive, player-facing experiences.

Native support for OpenTelemetry (OTel) - Capture and analyze logs, traces, and in-game performance data in real time. With ClickHouse’s native integration with the OpenTelemetry Collector, developers can efficiently monitor player experience, detect anomalies, and perform crash analytics, ensuring seamless gameplay with low-latency telemetry queries.

Secure by design, built for compliance - Protect sensitive player data with Customer Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK), support for BYOC deployments, fine-grained access controls, and built-in compliance features like GDPR-ready TTLs and lightweight deletes.
